case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Fastener kit consolidation – revised package
move.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your quotation. Could you separate the kit price into component costs, picking/packing and distribution, and identify the savings from consolidating all four items?

According to ctr:4600070610, the contractual payment term is 90 days; please retain that term for the bundled supply.

We propose €5.00 per kit with a 24-month commitment, giving you a longer planning horizon in exchange for improved pricing. Would a 36-month commitment unlock a further reduction?

Please confirm that the quoted five-day delivery service covers the complete kit.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month commitment, which allows us to offer a revised price of €5.58 per kit. We can also accept the 90-day payment term as requested for this bundled supply. 

To present our complete Angebot, our current terms are a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please be aware that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
